svg.aria-label: Dual-axis solar tracker at a glance. Two axes: azimuth east to west and elevation north to south. A closed light loop of four sensors, with no clock or location to set. Standalone power from a 12 volt panel and battery through a charge controller. Parks facing east at night and waits for sunrise. Build: Arduino Uno, a 4-channel relay H-bridge, two 12 volt 500 mm linear actuators, a RAGGE RG-50SD charge controller, a 12 volt lead-acid battery, and a welded steel frame. Built in 2018.
svg.text: Arduino, light-balancing control, two linear actuators. Built 2018.
